region.description: Region where this resource will be [managed](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/rande.html#regional-endpoints). Defaults to the Region set in the [provider configuration](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/hashicorp/aws/latest/docs#aws-configuration-reference).

role.description: ARN referencing the IAM role assumed by S3 when replicating tables.

rule.description: Replication rules. See [Rule](#rule) below for more details.

destination.description: Replication destination. See [Destination](#destination) below for more details.

table_arn.description: ARN referencing the Table that owns this replication configuration.
